repos_data.description: A Go toolkit for building AI agents and applications across multiple providers. Unified LLM client, agent framework with handoffs, tool calling, streaming, structured output, MCP integration, and cost tracking.
The AI Toolkit for TypeScript. From the creators of Next.js, the AI SDK is a free open-source library for building AI-powered applications and agents
Durable execution framework for AI agents in Go. Keeps agent state, tool calls, and execution loops resilient across process crashes.
Orchestration of autonomous, collaborative AI agents in Go — an idiomatic Go port of CrewAI.

AI gateway / AI control plane / AI proxy written in Go. Unified OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible API for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, xAI, Ollama, vLLM and more. A LiteLLM alternative with observability, guardrails, streaming, cost tracking, intelligent routing, sticky sessions, failover, real-time logs and usage tracking. Prod ready.

Multi-agent orchestration & workflow engine. Declarative YAML workflows, LLM coordinator with hub-and-spoke mailboxes, race-safe delivery. One YAML file, one Go binary. Runs on any goai-supported provider.

The fastest, litest AI Gateway. Rust core with Python SDK. Call 100+ LLM APIs in OpenAI (or native) format with cost tracking, guardrails, load balancing, and logging [Bedrock, Azure, OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenAI, VertexAI, vLLM, Nvidia NIM]
Know what your AI agents cost. API gateway with budget enforcement, session tracking, and MCP tools.

A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides AI-powered search and querying capabilities for the Vercel AI SDK documentation. This project enables developers to ask questions about the Vercel AI SDK and receive accurate, contextualized responses based on the official documentation.
Open source LLM observability and monitoring. Drop-in proxy for OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini with request logging, cost tracking, and agent tracing. Self-host with one Docker command. MIT.
Unified LLM API, structured data outputs with LLMs, and agent SDK - in PHP
The TypeScript library for building AI applications.

repo_meta_data.description: Go AI SDK, the Go way.  One unified API across 21+ providers. Streaming, structured output, MCP support, stdlib only. Go AI SDK for AI applications inspired by Vercel AI SDK.
